assets.name: 命运之武器
assets.gameplay:
**第一件传说装备推荐**  (小技巧：7级前先不要买成装，看是否有命运之武器)

命运武器削弱后，穿透装备性价比不高了，以下为最新出装

刺客和战士： ![装备:无穷饥渴](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/222517.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)

ADC：攻速流  ![装备:破败王者之刃](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/223153.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)  暴击流 ![装备:无尽之刃](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/223031.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)

法师： ![装备:风暴狂涌](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/224646.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)或者 ![装备:视界专注](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/224628.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)

坦克： ![装备:千变者贾修](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/226665.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)  ![装备:兰顿之兆](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/223143.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)  ![装备:败魔](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/222504.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)   根据对面阵容灵活选择

软辅： ![装备:黎明核心](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/226621.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)

装甲冲击

4个![装备:锁子甲](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/221031.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)可以合成 ![装备:冰脉护手](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/226662.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)  ![装备:荆棘之甲](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/223075.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)  ![装备:千变者贾修](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/226665.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)  ![装备:无终恨意](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/222502.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)

2个 ![装备:守望者铠甲](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/3082.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1) 可以合成 ![装备:兰顿之兆](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/223143.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)  ![装备:冰霜之心](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/223110.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)

如果是战士英雄，可以把 ![装备:无终恨意](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/222502.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1) 换成 ![装备:死亡之舞](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/226333.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)

assets.gameplay: 无论刺客或者法师拿到，都可出 ![装备:无尽之刃](https://cdn.cchappy.top/hks/assets/hextech-aram/items/223031.png?imageView2/1/w/64/h/64/format/webp/q/75/ignore-error/1)，可以增加暴击伤害，比暴击书的性价比高
